nms_standard: perform non-maximum suppression on axis-aligned bounding boxes with IoU threshold filtering
soft_nms: apply soft NMS that reweights scores instead of discarding overlapping boxes
batched_nms: run batched NMS across multiple object classes with per-class or class-agnostic suppression
nms_match: match detected boxes into groups where each group contains a kept box and its suppressed neighbors
nms_rotated: perform NMS on rotated bounding boxes specified by center, width, height, and angle
